source: The mouse GABAergic types can be roughly divided into two groups based on the expression of key transcriptional regulators (Sox14, Lef1, Otx2, Nkx2-2, and Dlx5) that reflect their developmental origin in the midbrain (Sox14+) or forebrain (Sox14-) (Scholpp and Lumsden, 2010; Jager et al., 2021).
